machine: Apple M4 Max, 36 GiB unified memory

precision.experimental_bf16_inputs: Eligible multi-token TensorOps projections only; outputs and recurrent state remain F32.

limitations: Shared machine; substantial load changes, sequential runtime measurements, loading excluded from warm latency.
Two opposite runtime orders for the invoice; six warm requests per runtime.
Four synthetic smoke pages only; not a representative accuracy, dense-page, grounding, or CUDA evaluation.
Native direct encoded-image read API includes request setup and cleanup; PyTorch includes preprocessing and generation but excludes output text decoding.
Text agreement does not establish token/logit parity.
Final defaults were checked on invoice and receipt; final letter/shipping repeats were resource-limited. The projection-only round checked all four pages.
GPU-frame and CPU profiles use separate instrumented requests and are excluded from warm latency samples.
implementation: Model-scoped M4 Max BF16 vector GEMV, including 32/64-output recurrent gates.
Single-token fused BF16 gate/up projection and SiLU with F32 math.
Optional Metal 4 TensorOps matrix path with F32 inputs by default; unsupported paths retain existing dispatch.
Parallel F32 RMS normalization for eligible 4B decode hidden/head shapes.
Independent test process/cache limits; production memory policy remains unchanged.

final_default_corpus_status.reason: A cold letter run was stopped after more than five minutes waiting for GPU completion. A bounded retry hit live-memory admission; a larger process envelope also failed initial live-memory admission. No output mismatch was observed.
